title: CSE20 — AWS Cloud Practitioner Practice Quiz (Modules 1–5)

questions.question: Which of the following is a key advantage of cloud computing over traditional on-premises infrastructure?
options: Trade capital expense for variable expense
Guessing your capacity needs far in advance
Owning and maintaining your own data centers
questions.answer: Trade capital expense for variable expense
questions.explanation: In the cloud you pay only for what you consume instead of investing upfront in hardware.

questions.question: A company wants to stop guessing about capacity and instead scale resources up or down to match demand. Which cloud benefit is this?
questions.explanation: Elasticity means provisioning resources to match demand, avoiding over- or under-provisioning.

questions.question: Which cloud deployment model runs some resources on-premises and connects them to resources in the cloud?
questions.explanation: A hybrid model combines cloud resources with existing on-premises infrastructure.

questions.question: What does the cloud benefit 'economies of scale' mean for AWS customers?
options: A fixed monthly fee regardless of usage
Aggregated usage from many customers leads to lower pay-as-you-go prices
You must reserve capacity for three years
Costs rise as more customers join
questions.answer: Aggregated usage from many customers leads to lower pay-as-you-go prices
questions.explanation: AWS aggregates usage across customers, achieving scale and passing the savings on.

questions.question: Which cloud service model provides the fundamental building blocks — compute, storage, and networking — that the customer configures and manages?
questions.explanation: IaaS gives you the basic infrastructure (like virtual servers) that you manage yourself.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of Software as a Service (SaaS)?
questions.explanation: SaaS delivers a finished application over the internet; web email is a classic example.

questions.question: Which AWS tool lets you estimate the monthly cost of a planned architecture BEFORE you build it?
questions.explanation: The AWS Pricing Calculator estimates costs for workloads you are planning.

questions.question: A company wants an alert when its monthly spend is forecast to exceed a set threshold. Which service fits best?
questions.explanation: AWS Budgets lets you set custom cost/usage limits and receive alerts.

questions.question: Which Amazon EC2 purchasing option offers the deepest discount but can be interrupted by AWS with little notice?
questions.explanation: Spot uses spare AWS capacity at large discounts, but the capacity can be reclaimed.

questions.question: Which pricing model lets you pay for compute by the second/hour with no long-term commitment or upfront payment?
questions.explanation: On-Demand charges for what you use with no commitment — ideal for short or unpredictable workloads.

questions.question: Which AWS Support plan provides a designated Technical Account Manager (TAM)?
questions.explanation: A designated TAM is a feature of Enterprise Support; Basic and Developer do not include one.

questions.question: Which service inspects your environment and gives real-time best-practice checks for cost, performance, security, fault tolerance, and service limits?
questions.explanation: Trusted Advisor evaluates your account against best practices across those five categories.

questions.question: What best describes an AWS Availability Zone (AZ)?
options: One or more discrete data centers with redundant power and networking inside a Region
A global network of content caches
questions.answer: One or more discrete data centers with redundant power and networking inside a Region
questions.explanation: An AZ is one or more physically separate data centers within a Region.

questions.question: To make an application highly available, where should you deploy its resources?
questions.explanation: Spreading across multiple AZs protects the app from a single data-center failure.

questions.question: Which part of the AWS global infrastructure caches content close to users and is used by Amazon CloudFront?
questions.explanation: Edge locations serve cached content near users to reduce latency.

questions.question: What is an AWS Region?
options: A geographic area made up of multiple, isolated Availability Zones
questions.answer: A geographic area made up of multiple, isolated Availability Zones
questions.explanation: A Region is a physical geographic location containing multiple AZs.

questions.question: A company must keep its data inside a specific country for legal reasons. Which factor should MOST influence its Region choice?
options: The Region with the newest instance types
questions.explanation: Legal, compliance, and data-residency rules are primary drivers of Region selection.

questions.question: Which feature extends an AWS Region to place compute and storage nearer to end users for very low latency?
questions.explanation: Local Zones place select services close to large population centers as an extension of a Region.

questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which item is AWS responsible for?
options: Security OF the cloud — the physical infrastructure
questions.answer: Security OF the cloud — the physical infrastructure
questions.explanation: AWS secures the underlying infrastructure; the customer secures what they put in the cloud.

questions.question: Under the shared responsibility model, which task is the CUSTOMER responsible for?
options: Configuring IAM permissions and security groups
questions.answer: Configuring IAM permissions and security groups
questions.explanation: Customers manage their data, access control, and resource configuration ('in the cloud').

questions.question: What is the AWS best practice for the account root user?
options: Use it for daily administrative work
Share it with the admin team
Enable MFA on it and avoid using it for everyday tasks
questions.answer: Enable MFA on it and avoid using it for everyday tasks
questions.explanation: Protect the root user with MFA and use IAM users/roles for day-to-day work.

questions.question: An application on an EC2 instance needs temporary permission to read from Amazon S3. What should it use?
questions.explanation: IAM roles grant temporary credentials to instances/services without embedding long-term keys.

questions.question: Which AWS service protects web applications from common exploits such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting?
questions.explanation: AWS WAF (Web Application Firewall) filters malicious web requests using rules.

questions.question: Which service provides managed DDoS protection, with a Standard tier enabled automatically for all AWS customers at no extra cost?
questions.explanation: AWS Shield Standard gives automatic DDoS protection to all customers for free.

questions.question: What does Amazon VPC let you do?
options: Provision a logically isolated virtual network in the AWS Cloud
questions.answer: Provision a logically isolated virtual network in the AWS Cloud
questions.explanation: A VPC is your own isolated virtual network where you launch AWS resources.

questions.question: Which statement about security groups is correct?
options: They act as a virtual firewall at the instance level and are stateful
They operate at the subnet level
questions.answer: They act as a virtual firewall at the instance level and are stateful
questions.explanation: Security groups are stateful, instance-level firewalls; return traffic is allowed automatically.

questions.question: Which AWS service is a scalable DNS web service that also offers domain registration and health checks?
questions.explanation: Route 53 provides DNS resolution, domain registration, and routing/health checks.

questions.question: A company wants to deliver videos and static files to global users with low latency by caching at edge locations. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: CloudFront is AWS's content delivery network (CDN) that caches content at edge locations.

questions.question: Which service provides a dedicated, private network connection from an on-premises data center to AWS that does not travel over the public internet?
questions.explanation: Direct Connect creates a dedicated private link between your premises and AWS.

questions.question: Which best describes the difference between a security group and a network ACL (NACL)?
options: A security group is stateless; a NACL is stateful
A security group is instance-level and stateful; a NACL is subnet-level and stateless
Both operate only at the subnet level
NACLs can only allow traffic, never deny it
questions.answer: A security group is instance-level and stateful; a NACL is subnet-level and stateless
questions.explanation: Security groups guard instances (stateful); NACLs guard subnets (stateless, allow AND deny rules).
